facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Use was ou were + particípio: The video was shared. The pictures were saved. Use by para dizer quem fez.

facts.label: foi + particípio
facts.sub: Use was + particípio com um sujeito no singular: The video was shared. The post was deleted. O particípio dos verbos regulares termina em -ed: shared, liked, deleted, saved.

facts.label: foram + particípio
facts.sub: Use were + particípio com sujeito no plural ou you: The pictures were saved. Many people were invited. Atenção: pictures é plural, então não use was.

Peça um exemplo real da vida de cada aluno.
extra90: Aluno cria uma frase com cada ponto, sem olhar a tela.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “o vídeo foi compartilhado” e “as fotos foram salvas”.
compare.us: Em inglês, use was ou were + particípio: The video was shared. The pictures were saved. Use was para singular e were para plural. Para dizer quem fez, use by: The video was filmed by Ana. Não use o verbo ser sozinho com o verbo principal no passado.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: It was shared a lot.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The past passive uses was or were + participle.

items.why: Pictures is plural, so we say were saved.

items.s: We use by to say who did the action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The past passive uses was or were + participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes: was shared, were saved.)
We say “The pictures was saved.” → Falso (Pictures is plural, so we say were saved.)
We use by to say who did the action. → Verdadeiro (It was filmed by Ana.)
